chip.description: Sample-ROM bank switcher for a pair of OKI MSM6295 ADPCM chips: four independently banked regions per chip, with the sample table optionally banked in four pages alongside the sample data.
chip.notes: src/devices/machine/nmk112.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("NMK112 - NMK custom IC for bankswitching the sample ROMs of a pair of OKI6295 ADPCM chips"). Filed sound-pcm under taxonomy TB4 and §4.14, which place a sample-ROM address generator that exists only to drive a companion PCM channel in the sound branch.
